gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Paprika shouts in letters that sprawl apart, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Noto Sans Soyombo is the sans-serif counterweight, with a sizable x-height and curves whose wide mouths stay unclosed.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Paprika sprawls, commanding and loose, with lowercase as big as capitals. Noto Sans Sundanese sits beneath it as a plain sans, hardly any gap between its x-height and cap height, and its e crossbars stay open.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Paprika spreads its letters wide, the lowercase filling the line like capitals, with counters cut open like a hollow reed. And Noto Sans Sunuwar carries a longer passage gently, its curves leaving daylight and its short ascender stems rising from tall lowercase bodies.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-syloti-nagri: Commanding is Paprika's whole mood, loud and scattered. Paprika does its best work shouting with oversized lowercase, while Noto Sans Syloti Nagri, a plain sans, does its best quietly, with short ascenders, a tall x-height and an a whose lower bowl opens.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac has tall lowercase bowls like blown glass bulbs and s shapes that turn wide and easy. But Paprika is the one for display, scattering its letters apart and filling each line with capital-sized lowercase.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-syriac-weste: Expressive is the word for Paprika, its letters flung apart and its lowercase filling the line. And Noto Sans Syriac Western, a sans, answers by holding terminals far from the stroke while its small letters stack up tall like bundled cable.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Noto Sans Tagalog reads with a dense middle zone and generous gaps. Paprika blares above it in scattered, capital-sized lowercase, and the plain sans below simply lets the text run on without a fight.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tagbanwa: Paprika's lowercase swells to fill the line like capitals, and its counters breathe like a hollow reed cut open. Noto Sans Tagbanwa, a sans, reads smoothly through open curves.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tai-le: Loud, loose, capital-sized lowercase: that is Paprika. And Noto Sans Tai Le, a plain sans, has ink strokes tapering out before touching, so give it a size that lets those fine ends show.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-noto-sans-tai-tham: Big, bold and scattered, that is Paprika. And Noto Sans Tai Tham, a sans-serif, reads like chalk-board lowercase crowding the capital line, with each c open enough to see inside, so paragraphs move along easily.
